correctness.rationale: For the symmetric Q4 with forbidden positions (1,3),(2,4), rank<=1 points are singular since differentials of all 3x3 minors vanish; vv^t parametrization imposes u1u3=u2u4=0, four adjacent coordinate lines mapping to four Veronese conics. For rank2, smooth symmetric rank<=2 conormal Sym²(ker A) intersects the section conormal span{E13,E24} only if ker A is exactly span(e1,e3) or span(e2,e4), because det(aE13+bE24)=a²b². Thus singular rank2 points are exactly the opposite-coordinate two lines, giving a reduced K4-incidence union of six curves.
